method.name: sparse_cumulative_event_difference
method.stage_formula: mean(Pi)-mean(Pi-1); median of three process estimates
method.native_formula: median of 5 graph batch per-call means per process; median across processes
method.cache_protocol: natural K1→K2→K3→K4; rotating QKV; no prime/flush

ablation_policy.absolute_baseline: Use these frozen stage_us/native_chain_us, do not substitute a same-run B0.
ablation_policy.required_context: Same full CP chain, inputs SHA, buffer rotation, scope, C, probe placement/statistics.
ablation_policy.isolated_K3_old_runs: Historical diagnostics only; not directly subtractable from this baseline.
ablation_policy.immutability: Never overwrite; new measurements require an explicit new ID.

limitations: Stage values are differences of cumulative Event means, not simultaneous direct per-kernel timestamps.
Remaining marker-position/cache/clock bias is not eliminated merely because sums close.
No HBM/L2 traffic measured here; natural cache history is not a guarantee of HBM residency.
Unsegmented graph E2E is GPU-only batch per-call mean, not host public API wall time.
No time→cycle conversion without time-window-matched clock evidence.
